# New Star Cleaning

> Locally owned cleaning company in Fresno, California. Residential,
> office, commercial, and post-construction cleaning for Fresno, Clovis,
> Madera, and Fresno neighborhoods including North Fresno, Woodward Park,
> Fig Garden, and Tower District. Call or text (559) 785-2822. Quotes are
> confirmed before anything is booked.

Key facts:

- Business: NEW STAR CLEANING LLC, Fresno, CA
- Owner: Angel Barranco; cleaning homes in the Fresno area since 2020
- Serving Fresno, Clovis, Madera, and nearby Fresno neighborhoods (North Fresno, Woodward Park, Fig Garden, Tower District)
- Phone: (559) 785-2822 (call or text). Email: support@newstarcleaning.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 5 PM, Sunday closed
- Insurance: We carry general liability insurance
- Cleaners bring their own cleaning supplies
- Residential starting prices: Standard cleaning from $165, Deep cleaning from $235, Move-in / move-out cleaning from $325
- Optional priced add-ons (confirmed before the visit): inside oven, inside refrigerator, cabinet interiors (included when empty on move-in/move-out), interior window glass and tracks, and carpet shampooing (priced by room, hallway, or stairway)
- Not offered: laundry, dishes, bed making, organizing, packing, heavy furniture moving, biohazard cleanup, exterior windows, pressure washing, restoration work
- Before/after photos on the site come from real New Star appointments; the site uses no stock photography

## Services

- [Recurring & standard house cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/standard-cleaning): weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or one-time upkeep for maintained homes (from $165)
- [Deep house cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/deep-cleaning): detailed reset for kitchens, bathrooms, floors, baseboards, vents, and fixtures (from $235)
- [Move-in / move-out cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/move-out-cleaning): empty-home cleaning including cleared cabinets, drawers, and closets (from $325)
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/post-construction-cleaning): scoped final cleans for new builds, remodels, and tenant improvements
- [Office and commercial cleaning](https://newstarcleaning.com/services/commercial-cleaning): walkthrough-based cleaning for offices, clinics, behavioral-health and recovery facilities, and commercial spaces
